summary:
Independent review of Jinshu 086 against the sealed Chinese units. Closed, approvable years are only the conventional first-year labels 永甯初 / 301, 永興中 / 304–306, 永嘉初 / 307, 建興初 and 湣帝即位 / 313, and the 四載於茲 / 將降 / 逼遷天子 cluster / 316. Unresolved chronology cannot be approved. 泰始初 stays an onOrAfter-265 hold because the era opened in the twelfth month (十二月丙寅 already AD 266). The 漢末 deaths and anecdotes have no year. s0016 夜觀星象, 惠帝遣加, the post-即位 索輔 / 劉曜 / 麹陶 / 辛攀 sentences, 張軌's 卒年六十 / 在州十三年 death (313 vs conventional 建興二年 / 314), 軌卒 succession, and 湣帝's 崩問 (alive at 316 將降, dead by 太興 / 318) remain unresolved holds. One-sided onOrAfter bounds that are not marked unresolved stay approved as genuine lower bounds, not guessed years. 卒年六十 is kept as traditional-inclusive sui. Retrospective 諡曰武公 and speech-precedents do not feed life dates. Owned units were read for omitted birth, death, age, and date context: named 卒/斬/自刎/嘔血而死 events are present; 沒於賊 is not forced into a death year; no birth year is written.
Independent review of Jin Shu 86 units s0211–s0420 (owned slice) against the sealed Chinese, not the English. Conventional AD labels used here are reign-year labels, not month/day conversions: Min Jianxing 1–4 = 313–316, Jianxing 6 (Liang continued) = 318, Taixing 1 = 318, Taixing 3 = 320, Yongchang opens 322 (era runs into early 323), Taining 1–3 = 323–325, Xianhe 1 = 326. Academia Sinica defaults to Julian before 1582; no owned row has a verified month/day that needed proleptic-Gregorian normalization. Most chronology is supported: 是歲 太興 / 建興六年 relief acts at 318; 太興三年 plot/deaths at 320; 建興四年 enfeoffment at 316; 二年 after 建興初 as Jianxing 2 = 314; 歲餘/明年/未幾 kept as open after-320 / onOrBefore-322 sequences; 建興初 / 永昌初 / 咸和初 kept as era-opening bounds; Jin Shu vs Tongjian Taining clashes (Mao death, Jun investiture, Yuan Di death-news, Fuhan/Wang Zhi) left unresolved; sui ages (十歲, 年十八, 年四十八) not converted to birth years; later citations split into undated attestation plus retrospective-reference and kept out of life hints. Defects: claim-453 mixes Min’s 316–318 death window with the Hexi reception date; hints-p131, hints-p150, and hints-p176–p179 turn one-sided bounds into apparent exact years. Owned units were also read for omitted 卒/薨/殺/年: Bao, Shi, Hong, Yan Sha, Jia Mo, and Mao deaths and the three sui figures are present; 年幼 / 幼而奇偉 are qualitative and were correctly left unnumbered; Zhao Yang is not named at s0261 and has no inferred death.
Independent review of Jinshu ch. 86 owned units s0421–s0629 (s0494 absent). Named era-years that convert cleanly remain supported at year precision: 太興二年 = AD 319, 咸和八年/九年 = 333/334, 永和元年/二年 = 345/346, plus sui ages 四十/十六/二十七 and undated attestations with no year claimed. Unresolved chronology is not approved. 咸和初, 建興中, 後/自後 after 咸和九年, 馬岌上言 after 永和元年, the long 永和二年 sequel, undated 追諡, 季龍自斃, and deaths stated without a new era-year stay research-blocked: the Chinese gives only a floor or a mid-era/duration label, and no Western year is invented. Active hints that repeat those floors are blocked with the events; empty hints on undated or reception-only people, and closed-year hints for 張駿/重華/耿訪/賈陵/王豐/嚴氏/馬氏, remain supported. Findings tell repair to keep unresolved:true rather than close encyclopedia years.
Independent review of Jinshu 86 owned units s0630–s0841 (including s0842 永和十年). Year-labeled events that Jinshu itself dates—永和十年 / 和平元年 = AD 354, 建興四十三年 = 355, 建興四十九年 / 升平 = 361, 興寧元年 = 363, 太和初 on or after 366, 太元元年 = 376, 隆安中 = 397–401, and 淮肥 as the conventional AD 383 battle year—remain supported as conventional regnal-year labels, not month/day Gregorian dates. Ages 十歲 / 年十四 / 十八九 / 年六十一 stay as text. Unresolved chronology cannot be approved. Research-blocked clusters are: (1) Zuo's fall and Lady Ma's 出殿, where Jinshu never writes 永和十一年 and ZZTJ 閏月 competes; (2) the Lian Qi / Li Yan / Wang Meng campaign and Chang Ju's 征東 title, where Jinshu has no year and ZZTJ 367 / 晉記 368 compete; (3) 立子大懷 / 廢大懷; (4) undated 穆帝/孝武帝 賜諡; (5) Tianxi's 尋卒,年六十一, which is not 義熙二年; (6) the undated 追贈; and (7) undated appraisal/heading reception. Those checks are research-blocked with findings; no year was invented.

findings.problem: Jinshu never writes 永和十一年 for Zhang Zuo's last campaign, Zhang Ling's river defeat, Zhang Song's street levy, or 呼重華母馬氏出殿. Those acts sit after 永和十年 (s0842) and by 建興四十三年 (s0699). ZZTJ 永和十一年閏月 is a competing witness, not a Jinshu sourceDate.
findings.action: Keep unresolved:true. Do not certify AD 355 as an exact event year or adopt ZZTJ's intercalary month. Leave westernBounds as onOrAfter 354 / onOrBefore 355. Do not identify any later unmarked 馬氏 as p279.

findings.problem: s0763–s0767 and s0765 have no year. Jinshu writes 太和初 only at s0753. ZZTJ 太和二年 (AD 367) and 晉記 太和三年春 (AD 368) are competing external years for the Lian Qi / Li Yan / Wang Meng campaign and for Chang Ju's 征東將軍 title.
findings.action: Keep unresolved:true. Floor onOrAfter 366 from 太和初 and ceiling onOrBefore 376 from 太元元年. Do not certify 366, 367, or 368. Do not treat Chang Ju's Taiyuan 1 death as the appointment year.

findings.problem: s0769 立子大懷為世子 has no year and is not the s0753 太和初 Jin appointment. s0775 廢大懷為高昌公 is also undated.
findings.action: Keep the heir-establishment envelope unresolved between 太和初 and 太元元年. Leave the deposition as an undated attestation. Do not invent a year for either event.

findings.problem: s0631 穆帝賜諡曰敬烈 and s0746 孝武帝賜諡曰敬悼公 write 私諡/賜諡 with no year. Dating either grant as the emperor's entire reign is the defect.
findings.action: Keep unresolved:true. Do not invent a year, do not expand the grant to a reign-long interval, and do not feed 賜諡 into life dates or active hints.

findings.problem: s0820 尋卒，年六十一 follows 桓玄時 and gives no era year. Jinshu does not write 義熙二年. Later tables disagree (commonly 406 vs a 398 reading).
findings.action: Keep the death unresolved. Do not certify 398 or 406. Preserve 年六十一 as age text without converting it into a birth year. Keep 太和初 / 太元元年 / 淮肥 living dates; keep 追贈 off the life-year hints.

findings.problem: s0821 追贈金紫光祿大夫 follows 尋卒 and has no era year.
findings.action: Keep the posthumous award as unresolved retrospective reception. Do not use it as a life date or active hint.

findings.problem: The chapter heading s0697 and the closing appraisal s0824–s0835 give no year for these retrospective references (Yaoling-as-brother, 士彥/周公, Zuo, Tianxi, 大禹, 摯虞, 侯瑾).
findings.action: Keep unresolved:true. Do not import 2100 BC, 1042 BC, Yongning 1, AD 170, or 義熙二年. Do not treat appraisal dates as life dates or active hints.

references.title: 永宁 (西晋)
references.quote: 永宁（ 301年四月—302年十一月）是西晋皇帝晋惠帝司马衷的第五个年号
references.reason: Confirms conventional 永寧元年 = AD 301 and that the era opened in the fourth month, so 永甯初 as a closed 301 reign-year label does not cross a Western New Year.

references.title: 永兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 永兴（ 304年十二月—306年六月）是西晋皇帝晋惠帝司马衷的第八个年号
references.reason: Confirms conventional 永興 = AD 304–306 as the era span used for 永興中. Conventional year labels need not equal the Gregorian year of the twelfth-month opening.

references.title: 永嘉 (西晋)
references.quote: 永嘉（ 307年—313年四月）是西晋皇帝晋怀帝司馬熾的年号
references.reason: Confirms conventional 永嘉元年 = AD 307 (opened in the first month) for 永嘉初 closures.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 建兴（ 313年四月—317年三月）是西晋皇帝晉愍帝司馬鄴的年号
references.reason: Confirms 建興元年 = AD 313 and that Jianxing 4 is the conventional fourth year (AD 316) used from 四載於茲, not from a written 建興四年 in the chapter.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 建兴四年晉愍帝投降前赵，西晋灭亡。
references.reason: Independent witness that Chang'an's surrender belongs to Jianxing 4 / AD 316, matching 四載於茲 after a 313 accession.

references.title: 大兴 (东晋)
references.quote: 大兴（或作太兴； 318年三月—321年）是东晋皇帝晉元帝司馬睿的第二个年号
references.reason: Confirms 太興元年 = AD 318 and therefore 建興六年 in the same year, used only as context for later Zhang Shi / Yuan Di rows.

references.title: 泰始 (西晋)
references.quote: 晉武帝改元泰始时（乙酉年十二月丙寅）已是公元266年2月8日。
references.reason: Shows why 泰始初 cannot be closed as Gregorian 265: the era-opening day is already AD 266. Supports leaving claim-566 unresolved with onOrAfter 265.

references.title: 中央研究院 兩千年中西曆轉換
references.quote: 在此之前的西曆稱為儒略(Julian)曆
references.reason: Records Academia Sinica's default Julian setting before 1582. No owned row was converted from a month/day that would flip the Western year under that default; reign-year labels were kept as conventional years.

references.title: 通鉴纪事本末卷十三下
references.quote: 己丑，轨薨，长史张玺等表世子寔摄父位。
references.reason: The Tongjian tradition dates Zhang Gui's death to Jianxing 2 / the fifth month, which is the conventional 314 reading. The chapter never writes 二年, so that witness stays competing with inclusive 在州十三年 / 313 rather than winning.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 建兴（ 313年四月—317年三月）是西晋皇帝晉愍帝司馬鄴的年号
references.reason: Primary calendar witness for Min’s Jianxing: year 1 = AD 313, year 2 = 314, year 4 = 316; Former Liang 建興六年 = 318.

references.title: 大兴 (东晋)
references.quote: 大兴（或作太兴； 318年三月—321年）是东晋皇帝晉元帝司馬睿的第二个年号
references.reason: Confirms 太興元年 = AD 318 and 大興三年 = AD 320, matching s0234 and s0260.

references.title: 永昌 (东晋)
references.quote: 永昌（ 322年—323年二月）是东晋皇帝晉元帝司馬睿的第三个年号
references.reason: Yongchang opens in AD 322 and runs into early 323, so 永昌初 is onOrAfter 322 and must not be closed as year 1 alone.

references.title: 太宁 (东晋)
references.quote: 太宁（ 323年三月—326年正月）是东晋皇帝晉明帝司馬紹的年号
references.reason: Taining 1/2/3 = conventional AD 323/324/325, the three years left competing on Mao’s death and Jun’s early acts.

references.title: 咸和 (东晋)
references.quote: 咸和（ 326年二月—334年）是东晋皇帝晉成帝司馬衍的第一个年号
references.reason: Xianhe 1 conventionally AD 326, so 咸和初 is onOrAfter 326 and not a closed 326–327 interval.

references.title: 中央研究院 兩千年中西曆轉換
references.quote: 在此之前的西曆稱為儒略(Julian)曆
references.reason: Converter defaults to Julian before 1582. No owned event has a verified month/day requiring a proleptic-Gregorian day conversion; year-labels above remain conventional AD years.

references.quote: 夏，五月，甲申，張茂疾病，執世子駿手泣曰

references.quote: 春，正月，張駿承元帝凶問，大臨三日。
references.reason: Tongjian under 太寧三年 (AD 325) dates Jun’s receipt of Yuan Di death-news, competing with Jin Shu s0335–s0336 太寧元年.

references.title: 資治通鑑卷第九十三 晉紀十五
references.quote: 會韓璞攻掠趙秦州諸郡
references.reason: Tongjian places the Dou Tao / Zhang Lang / Xin Yan Qinzhou column under 二年（丁亥、三二七）= 咸和二年, the competing witness kept beside Jin Shu 咸和初.

references.title: 大兴 (东晋) — 维基百科
references.quote: 大兴（或作太兴； 318年三月—321年）是东晋皇帝晉元帝司馬睿的第二个年号，共计4年。
references.reason: Year-level conversion for s0461 太興二年: 大興/太興元年 = AD 318, so 二年 = conventional AD 319 (Yuan of Jin). No month/day in the Chinese, so the Western year is the conventional regnal label, not a proleptic-Gregorian day.

references.title: 咸和 (东晋) — 维基百科
references.quote: 咸和（ 326年二月—334年）是东晋皇帝晉成帝司馬衍的第一个年号，共计9年。
references.reason: Year-level conversion for 咸和: 元年 begins 太寧四年二月 (AD 326), 八年 = conventional AD 333, 九年 = AD 334 (Cheng of Jin). 咸和初 is therefore an onOrAfter 326 floor, not a closed 326–327 pair. Lunar-month tables on the same page show late-year months can spill into the next Western year; that does not rewrite year-only labels.

references.title: 咸和 (东晋) — 维基百科 (改元)
references.quote: 太寧四年（326年）二月二十七日，改元為咸和元年。
references.reason: Confirms 咸和元年 is Cheng of Jin’s first era year in AD 326, so 咸和初 cannot be dated before 326 and need not be rewritten as exact Xianhe 1.

references.title: 永和 (东晋) — 维基百科
references.quote: 永和（345年—356年）是东晋皇帝晋穆帝司马聃的第一个年号，共计12年。
references.reason: Year-level conversion for 永和元年 = conventional AD 345 and 永和二年 = AD 346 (Mu of Jin). Post-永和二年 sequels stay onOrAfter 346. Yonghe 9 = AD 353 is on this table but is not in the owned Chinese death notice.

references.title: 永和 (东晋) — 维基百科 (改元)
references.quote: 建元元年（345年）正月四日，改元为永和元年。
references.reason: Confirms Yonghe 1 opens in AD 345, so Zhang Jun’s 永和元年 appointment and the 345–346 death window after that year are conventional year labels, not month/day Gregorian dates.
